caveats: Requires a config reload or new TLS connection policy provisioning (register path) or a context cancel (unregister path) to overlap in time with a STEK rotation tick; rotation ticks are infrequent by default (12h) so the window is narrow but nonzero.
Requires the standard deployment where SessionTicketService.start() has spawned the stayUpdated goroutine and rotation is not disabled.
subclaims.reason: In R5, stayUpdated copies only the map header (configs := s.configs, modules/caddytls/sessiontickets.go:140), releases the mutex (sessiontickets.go:141), then ranges over the shared map (sessiontickets.go:142-144) with no lock held. Concurrently, register inserts into the same map (sessiontickets.go:171) from the connection-policy provisioning path (modules/caddytls/connpolicy.go:244), and unregister deletes from it (sessiontickets.go:184) via an OnCancel callback (connpolicy.go:250). The lock is held during the mutation but not during the iteration, so there is no common lock across the two sides, and no channel, mutex, or goroutine-start ordering rules the overlap out. Concurrent map iteration and map write is a data race and fatal at runtime in Go.
